explanation: Methodology limitation, not a player-level finding: on_off has a near-zero season mean/stddev, making the z-score formula hypersensitive -- nearly any nonzero value reads as extreme regardless of real magnitude. Mixes genuine stars (Tadic, Reijnders) with unknowns at similarly wild z-scores, confirming this is a metric-scaling issue, not 8 individual stories. See known_issues.md.
